de: Jacques Cartier, navigator and explorer, returns home to St. Malo after claiming Stadacona (Quebec), Hochelaga (Montreal) and the River of Canada (St. Lawrence River) region for France.

te: The Spanish town of Arjona declares independence and names its native Muhammad ibn Yusuf as ruler. This marks the Muham…
dz: 西班牙城镇阿尔乔纳宣布独立,并命名其本土的穆罕默德·伊本·优素福为统治者. 这标志着穆罕默德第一次上升到显要地位;他后来建立了格拉纳达的纳斯里德酋长国,是西班牙最后一个独立的穆斯林国家.
de: The Spanish town of Arjona declares independence and names its native Muhammad ibn Yusuf as ruler. This marks the Muhammad's first rise to prominence; he later established the Nasrid Emirate of Granada, the last independent Muslim state in Spain.

te: After Pope Innocent III calls European knights to a crusade, the forces of kings Alfonso VIII of Castile, Sancho VII of…
dz: 拉斯·纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨战役:教宗英诺森三世召欧洲骑士为十字军后,卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世,纳瓦雷国王桑乔七世,阿拉贡国王彼得二世和葡萄牙国王阿丰索二世的军队击败了柏柏尔穆斯林领袖阿尔莫哈德的军队,从而标志着重新征服和西班牙中世纪史上的一个重要转折点.
de: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa: After Pope Innocent III calls European knights to a crusade, the forces of kings Alfonso VIII of Castile, Sancho VII of Navarre, Peter II of Aragon and Afonso II of Portugal defeat those of the Berber Muslim leader Almohad, thus marking a significant turning point in the Reconquista and in the medieval history of Spain.

t: 三位罗马议员在星期六下午的神灵仪式上,在Hagia Sophia的祭坛上,将一头反对君士坦丁堡…
te: Three Roman legates place - acting illegally on their own authority - a bull of excommunication against Michael I Cerul…
dz: 三位罗马议员在星期六下午的神灵仪式上,在Hagia Sophia的祭坛上,将一头反对君士坦丁堡宗主迈克尔一世·塞鲁莱乌斯的公牛非法置于自己的权力之下。 历史学家经常将事件描述为"东西施教"的正式起步.
de: Three Roman legates place - acting illegally on their own authority - a bull of excommunication against Michael I Cerularius, the patriarch of Constantinople, and his followers on the altar of Hagia Sophia during Saturday afternoon divine liturgy. Historians frequently describe the event as the formal start of the East–West Schism.

de: Battle of Spercheios: Bulgarian forces of Tsar Samuel are defeated by a Byzantine army under general Nikephoros Ouranos at the Spercheios River in Greece.
